research_statement: D-2 was reformulated because TWO OF FOUR grounds were falsified by F0024, while two stood.
current_representation: Derivation as a binary edge premise->conclusion
missing_capability: individually addressable premises within one derivation
why_insufficient: A binary edge cannot carry four premises of which two are refuted. Collapsing to 'partially falsified' loses WHICH two.
proposed_experiment: represent DI-0009 with n-ary premises and re-derive D-2's surviving ground

research_statement: Five rival readings were registered, each with a discriminator and an outcome class; one is UNRESOLVABLE_BY_RECONSTRUCTION.
missing_capability: a record holding N formulations + a discriminator + a discriminator CLASS + an outcome class
why_insufficient: CMP-0001 holds THREE rival readings, not two, and its discriminator is a conjunction of two lookups. An edge cannot carry that.
proposed_experiment: attempt CMP-0001 as edges only; show the 3-way structure is lost
note: ⭐ REVERSES an architecture-review adjudication. Competition was classified PREMATURE on the ground that the corpus never calls these competitions. CONSTRUCTION demanded it anyway. Evidence overrides the architectural judgement.

research_statement: bar is undefined, and that undefinedness BLOCKS STR-0001 from reaching F2.
current_representation: none — an open term has no representation
missing_capability: an OpenTerm object that a structure can depend on and that blocks its stage promotion
why_insufficient: Without it, 'S-1 is F1' is a bare assertion rather than a consequence of a named unresolved term.
proposed_experiment: model bar as an OpenTerm with 3 candidate bindings; check STR-0001 auto-caps at F1

research_statement: Propagation of the C-0007 falsification was TESTED across the four later files and found to be zero.
missing_capability: a SearchRecord — scope, method, outcome, provenance — so a NEGATIVE result is a recorded act
why_insufficient: Without it, 'did not propagate' is indistinguishable from 'not checked'. Step-1 §37 check 13 requires ABSENT_BY_CONTENT to be earned.
proposed_experiment: record the propagation test as Event(kind=SEARCH); check the four absence states remain distinguishable

research_statement: All 11 seed items are M1; none reached M2 because no independent reader was available.
missing_capability: maturity as a COMPUTED value over executed tests + reader independence — never writable
why_insufficient: A writable field permits M2 to be set without a reader, which §11.0 forbids and Q22 cannot enforce structurally.
proposed_experiment: remove the setter; verify M2 is unreachable without an AuthorityAct-equivalent independence record

research_statement: EM-0003 and EM-0004 are claims about the corpus's METHOD, not about KnowledgeOS.
missing_capability: a distinction between theory-claims and method-claims
why_insufficient: Typing a method-claim as 'Principle' puts it in the same bucket as theory content — the level confusion F0014 tabulates four instances of.
proposed_experiment: classify all 23 Step-1 objects as theory-claim vs method-claim; count ambiguous
note: ⭐ A finding about STEP 1, produced by Step 2. Routed to obligations — ⛔ Step-1 artifacts are not modified (Q17).

research_statement: F0018's own worked example is not representable in the schema F0018 analyses.
missing_capability: a product type P x S
why_insufficient: ⭐ This is not our model's gap — it is a gap IN THE CORPUS'S ARTIFACT that our model can now name. The laboratory must be able to record that the SUBJECT is underspecified, distinct from the instrument being underspecified.
proposed_experiment: represent SI-0007 and check it is classified as a finding about authorities.yaml, not about the lab
note: ⭐ Exercises the THEORY / PROTOCOL / INSTRUMENT separation (§10.3c) from an angle none of the three covers: a defect in the OBJECT STUDIED.
